2610.06411.title: From Benchmark to Bench: Can Agents Survive Real-World Drug Discovery?
2610.06411.paper_summary: Agentic systems increasingly coordinate molecular-design tools, but it is unclear which layer of the stack limits outcomes on real projects. We developed MAGI, an open modular agent that authors objectives, launches and monitors optimization, interprets structure--activity relationships, and revises its strategy accordingly. MAGI generates molecules either directly through the LLM or by delegating to REINVENT 4, with scoring services interchangeable behind a common contract. We tested it across nine retrospective lead-optimization campaigns from three pharmaceutical companies, replayed under fixed temporal cutoffs. Both routes produced valid structures: LLM proposals stayed closer to local chemistry and reached comparable or higher primary activity in fewer operations, whereas REINVENT explored broader chemical space. Whether a campaign met its objective depended on the predictive models, not on the generation route: attainment followed model accuracy on the chemistry proposed, dropping once that chemistry moved outside the model's applicability domain. Separately, a blinded evaluation asked whether the MAGI's output could pass as expert work: chemists were not able to discriminate agentic proposals from held-out compounds, and judged the SAR reasoning broadly plausible yet incomplete. Together, these results position MAGI as a coordination layer pluggable into existing computational chemistry workflows. The ceiling on real projects, however, remains currently set by scorer applicability rather than by tool orchestration.
2610.06411.paper_summary_zh: 代理系統越來越多地協調分子設計工具，但尚不清楚堆疊的哪一層限制了實際項目的結果。 我們開發了MAGI，一個開放的模組化代理，能夠撰寫目標、啟動和監控優化、解釋結構-活性關係，並根據需要修訂其策略。 MAGI可以直接通過LLM生成分子，或通過REINVENT 4委派生成，並且在共同合約的背後，評分服務可以互換。我們在三家製藥公司的九個回顧性先導優化活動中測試了它，並在固定的時間截止下進行重播。 兩條路徑都產生了有效的結構：LLM提案更接近當地化學，並在較少的操作中達到了可比或更高的主要活性，而REINVENT則探索了更廣泛的化學空間。 一個活動是否達到其目標取決於預測模型，而不是生成路徑：達成情況跟隨所提議化學的模型準確性，當該化學超出模型的適用範圍時，達成情況會下降。 另外，一個盲評估詢問MAGI的輸出是否可以被視為專家的工作：化學家無法區分代理提案和保留化合物，並普遍認為SAR推理是合理的，但不完整。 總體而言，這些結果將MAGI定位為可插入現有計算化學工作流程的協調層。 然而，實際項目的上限目前仍然由評分器的適用性設定，而不是工具的協調。
